_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Check a Shopify CSV for customs data gaps...

description:
Best for: "which products have no HS code?" or "is my export ready for customs?". Checks a Shopify Inventory CSV (it holds HS Code and COO, country of origin) or product CSV for missing or malformed HS codes, origins, item identifiers (SKU or barcode) and invalid barcodes.
Returns: counts (null where the file has no such column), up to 200 rows with the problem on each, and notes on columns the file lacks.
Input tips: send csv, the file text exactly as exported with its header row, up to 2 MB.
Not for: suggesting the missing codes (use bulk_hs_candidates) or other spreadsheet formats. Nothing is stored: the input is used for this answer and dropped.

csv.description: The CSV text exactly as exported from Shopify, header row included, such as "Handle,Title,SKU,HS Code,COO" then the rows. At most 2 MB.

name: customs_data_gap_check

problem.description: What is wrong on the row, in plain words.

summary.description: A count is null when the file has no column to check it with.

truncated.description: true when more than 200 rows had problems and the list was cut.

title: Check a Shopify CSV for customs data gaps
